Class Game

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.model.Game
public class Game extends Object
Stores board dimensions, difficulty, target progress, and awarded points for one round.

  • Constructor Details

    • Game

      public Game(int x, int y, boolean powerUp, char difficulty)
      Creates a game with a board-sized target and difficulty defaults.
      Parameters:
      x - the board width in cells
      y - the board height in cells
      powerUp - whether special pickups are enabled
      difficulty - E, N, or H difficulty code

    • Game

      public Game(int x, int y, boolean powerUp, char difficulty, int targetScore, int speedMillis)
      Creates a game with either a board-sized target or a fixed level target and tick speed.
      Parameters:
      x - the board width in cells
      y - the board height in cells
      powerUp - whether special pickups are enabled
      difficulty - E, N, or H difficulty code
      targetScore - fixed reward target, or zero for the board-sized default
      speedMillis - base tick duration, or zero for difficulty defaults
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the target and speed are inconsistent or the difficulty is unsupported
